title: Заморозить adversarial verification contract и risk/proof manifest
summary: Создать один normative verification contract и exact machine-readable manifest, который связывает каждую security/durability/resource гарантию P1–P7 с oracle, failure model, обязательным red proof, execution tier и evidence carrier.
why: Текущие и запланированные tests распределены по фазам, но не существует одного проверяемого ответа, какой дефект обязан сделать какой gate красным; line coverage или pass count не доказывают чувствительность suite. `RAG:—`.

include: Инвентаризация P1 `G-*`/`NG-*`/`RL-*`, P2 confirmation/authorization, P3 replay/token, P4 lease/fencing, P5 event/audit, P6 semantic/JCS/MCP и P7 package boundaries; proof classes `example`, `property`, `differential`, `mutation`, `schedule`, `resource`; criticality; oracle independence; deterministic tier budgets; failure ownership; receipt schema; complete residual disposition.
exclude: Реализация generators/mutants/schedules/benchmarks; изменение upstream contract; CI workflow names/schedules; один global coverage/MSI target; автоматическое объявление RED defect эквивалентным.

rules: Every row has stable `AV-###`, upstream owner/reference, criticality, exact target surfaces, oracle/proof classes, named mutant/schedule/property IDs, finite tier budget, resource link and failure owner. Critical security/durability rows require at least one independent or external oracle plus one demonstrated red fault; ordinary duplicated implementation assertions do not satisfy independence. Tier names are workload semantics (`focused`, `bounded`, `extended`, `release-candidate`), not CI wiring; P9 maps them later. Randomized rows require algorithm+generator version, explicit seed list/case budget and promotion rule. Missing producer evidence is dependency-not-ready, never guessed.
guidance: Validator is stdlib-only, deterministic and exact-set: reject duplicate IDs, dangling owners, unknown proof/tier enums, critical rows without red proof, random rows without replay metadata and orphan mutant/schedule/corpus IDs. Keep the manifest as the machine owner; Markdown explains rationale and gaps without duplicating exact sets. Emit stable sorted JSON and source digests.

validation.expect: Source acceptance condition preserved in Validation section.

deliverables: Adversarial verification policy, exact risk/proof manifest, deterministic validator and complete P1–P7 proof-coverage report.
